cancel_confirm: You can start again later. Build progress will be lost.
progress_step_web_build: Build Web app and public sharing
unsupported: This hub is too old to check and update its version here. Update it once with install.sh on the hub machine, and it will work.
auto_notice: The hub updates itself when idle.
resolving_latest: Checking the latest version before updating…
check_unavailable: Checking isn't available for this source.
update_footer: The update waits until the assistant and all agents are idle before restarting the hub. If the new version won't start, it rolls back on its own. Connections drop briefly during the restart.
ahead_title: Running a newer version than this source
ahead_web_dev_title: Running a newer Web development build
ahead_web_dev_body: This hub is running a Web development build that is newer than the latest published release from this source. Downgrades aren't supported to protect database and state compatibility.
ahead_of_source: This hub is running a newer version than this source offers. Downgrades aren't supported to protect database and state compatibility.
ahead_next_step: Keep this source selected to update automatically or manually once a newer official release is published.
cannot_update_title: Updates aren't available for this source
cannot_next_step_config: After configuring a valid update.url in hub.json, restart the hub to enable update checks.
cannot_next_step_source_or_switch: Configure a valid update.url in hub.json and restart the hub, or switch back to an available update source above.
cannot_next_step_dev: Install an official release build on the hub machine to enable automatic updates.
cannot_next_step_dev_or_switch: Install an official release build to enable automatic updates, or switch to Web development above.
cannot_next_step_web_dev: Update hub.json on the hub machine and restart, or switch to Release or Beta above.
unchecked: Check for updates to see the latest version from this source.
auto_footer: When on, a new version installs itself once the assistant and all agents are idle, then sends a notification.
confirm_body: This won't wait for them to finish: anything waiting on the hub is interrupted (the assistant's current turn, file uploads, terminal connections). Agents in herdr aren't affected and reconnect once the hub is back.
nodes_footer: When automatic computer updates are off, open a computer and choose Redeploy to update it.
dev_nodes_footer: Assistants use verified packages from the hub first. If a platform has no package, the assistant needs Git and Go on its own computer to build the confirmed commit. For a manual update, open a computer and choose Redeploy.
mirror_manager_hint: Choose whose extension downloads to configure. Each assistant keeps its own settings.
mirror_scope: These settings apply only to this assistant and are stored in its database. Leave a field empty to use the original source.
registry_mirror_hint: An HTTPS registry base URL, optionally with a path prefix, such as https://registry.example.com/persona. Not a package or catalog URL.
catalog_mirror_hint: The complete HTTPS URL of the official catalog file, such as https://catalog.example.com/persona-extensions.json. Other markets are not redirected.
mirror_security: The assistant tries the mirror first and falls back to the original source if it fails. Official signatures and package SHA256 digests are still verified. Market tokens are never sent to mirrors.
mirror_invalid: Use an HTTPS URL without credentials, a query or a fragment.
mirror_response_invalid: The assistant returned invalid mirror settings. Retry before making changes.
beta_scope: Receives prereleases from the beta channel. Choose Release to return to stable updates; an update in progress must finish before switching.
dev_setup: Web development updates need a Linux or macOS hub that starts the built-in assistant.
dev_scope: The hub builds the web app and services from one commit. Once the hub confirms that commit, independent assistants update when idle. If an assistant fails to start, it restores its previous program.
dev_auto_footer: Off by default. When enabled, checks hourly, builds the selected commit and backs up history before updating when idle. Switching channels turns this off.
computer_auto_footer: Off by default. When on, each assistant updates the Persona service on supported computers after the hub confirms the commit. Offline computers can update when they reconnect.
program_backup_hint: Apply the saved programs and embedded Web. Keep the current database and history.
apply_backup_confirm: Apply this program version? The current database and history will be kept. A new backup is made before installation; development auto-update will be turned off. The update waits for running sessions to become idle.
dev_backup_footer: Use a private folder (0700) outside the data being backed up. Symlinks are rejected.
backup_folder_hint: Leave blank for the recommended folder. Custom paths must be absolute or start with ~.
backup_builtin: The hub pauses its own writers during the snapshot. Remote assistants with their own storage can keep working.
backup_external: A snapshot that includes another local assistant, extra databases or extra data folders requires both quiesce and resume commands in hub.json.
